results.summary: The product data can be approved with the clarification notes below. Assembly proof remains pending; confirm the listed assembly separately.

findings.title: VOC (air quality)
findings.detail: Package states < 10 g/L; spec requires at most 250 g/L.

findings.title: Missing mold resistance test data
findings.why_it_matters: Without the mold rating, we can’t verify long-term performance in damp areas.

highlights.quote: Tested by a third party independent laboratory to the ASTM G21 standard with Fungal Growth Rating results of zero.

findings.title: Assembly fire rating not yet confirmed
findings.detail: Product data does not establish a specific assembly's F/T ratings. Confirm the listed assembly separately.
findings.why_it_matters: We need to know the actual fire and temperature rating of the installed assembly to ensure it stops fire spread.

findings.title: Test standard reference needs clarification
findings.detail: Tested in accordance with ASTM E814, ASTM E119 or UL 1479.
findings.why_it_matters: Knowing which test was used lets us confirm the product was evaluated correctly for firestopping.

current_values.identity_quote: METACAULK® 1000 Highly Intumescent Firestop Sealant P R O D U C T D A T A S H E E T
current_values.scope_quote: Applications Metacaulk 1000 can be used in interior applications as a general purpose fire rated sealant and smoke seal for construction joints, through penetrations and blank openings on both vertical and horizontal surfaces. Use Metacaulk 1000 to prevent the spread of fire and smoke through joints in fire rated gypsum wallboard partitions, concrete block or concrete walls and/or concrete or corrugated steel deck floor/ceiling assemblies. Metacaulk 1000 is also an excellent fire rated acoustical sealant and can be used in areas under constant vibration or movement to reduce the transfer of noise through assemblies. Metacaulk 1000 can also be used on various penetrations such as EMT, telephone & power cables, insulated pipes, etc. in concrete floors and walls, gypsum walls as well as wood floors.
